All edge checks pass. Let me write HANDOFF.md and do a final full test run.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md << 'EOF'
# HANDOFF - cachetools milestone 1 (TaggedCache)

## Status: implemented
- src/cachetools/tagged.py: TaggedCache(maxsize) backed by LRUCache (via
  _TaggedLRUCache subclass that reports evictions so tag memberships and
  per-key tag tuples stay in sync).
- put(key, value, tags=()): deep-copies value on input; validates tags
  (finite iterable of str, no bare str, no non-str entries -> ValueError
  before any state change); dedupes tags preserving order; overwriting a
  key replaces its tag memberships and refreshes LRU recency (most
  recently used). Unhashable keys raise before mutation.
- get(key): detached deep copy; refreshes recency; KeyError when missing.
- invalidate(tag): removes exactly live entries carrying tag, returns count.
- len/currsize/maxsize/contains/getitem/delitem/pop/clear/repr provided.
- R03: maxsize positive int, bool excluded; every value costs one slot.
- Existing cachetools API untouched (only new module added).

## Tests
- tests/test_tagged.py (own tests, 23 cases) + acceptance_public.py pass.
- Full upstream suite: `PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ -q` -> 237 passed.

## Notes
- Eviction hook: _TaggedLRUCache.popitem -> TaggedCache.__evicted(key) removes
  stale tag memberships, so reused keys never carry old tags.
- Replacement removes old memberships *before* the LRU setitem so an eviction
  triggered during replacement cannot resurrect stale memberships.
- Claim-A extension (put refreshes recency on overwrite) implemented and tested
  (test_replacement_refreshes_recency, test_replacement_refreshes_recency_with_tag_change).
EOF
PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3"}
